overall_summary: A US-Iran peace deal is lifting Bitcoin toward $67K and setting a positive tone for crypto today. ETF outflows and hotter-than-expected CPI add some caution, but the geopolitical breakthrough is dominating risk sentiment. Traders are leaning bullish on the improved macro backdrop.

items.title: US-Iran Peace Deal Lifts Bitcoin Toward $67K
items.summary: Reports of an interim US-Iran agreement to end hostilities and reopen the Strait of Hormuz triggered a risk-on rally across markets. Bitcoin climbed to its highest level in nearly two weeks as oil prices fell and broader sentiment improved. Traders should watch whether this geopolitical relief sustains buying or fades into profit-taking.
items.impact: Supports short-term price recovery and reduces immediate macro headwinds.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs See $65M Net Outflow on June 15
items.summary: Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded roughly 65 million dollars in net outflows on June 15 according to multiple trackers. This continues a pattern of mixed or negative institutional flows in recent sessions despite the price bounce. Traders should monitor whether outflows accelerate or stabilize as a key driver of spot demand.
items.impact: Adds ongoing pressure to institutional buying and could cap upside.

items.title: Bank of Japan Raises Rates to 1 Percent
items.summary: The BOJ hiked its policy rate by 25 basis points to the highest level since 1995. The move raises the risk of further yen carry trade unwinding that could pressure global risk assets including crypto. Traders should track USD/JPY moves and any follow-through liquidity effects.
items.impact: Potential headwind for leveraged positions and risk appetite.

items.title: Tether Skips EU MiCA Authorization
items.summary: Tether announced it will not seek MiCA approval for USDT in the European Union. The decision keeps the stablecoin outside the bloc's new regulated framework for now. Traders should watch any impact on European liquidity or regulatory scrutiny elsewhere.
items.impact: Limited direct price impact but signals ongoing stablecoin regulatory divergence.

items.title: FOMC Meeting Begins Under New Chair Warsh
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's two-day policy meeting kicked off today, marking Kevin Warsh's first as chair. Markets overwhelmingly expect rates to hold steady at 3.5% to 3.75% given sticky inflation, with the real focus on tomorrow's updated economic projections and dot plot. Traders should watch for any shift in the Fed's tone or rate path signals that could influence risk assets and the dollar.
items.impact: High volatility expected around Wednesday's decision and press conference.

items.title: May Import and Export Prices Due Today
items.summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics releases May import and export price indexes at 8:30 a.m. ET, alongside housing starts and building permits data. These figures will provide fresh clues on imported inflation pressures and the health of the housing sector amid high mortgage rates. Crypto and broader markets may see modest moves if the prints deviate from forecasts showing mild import price gains.
items.impact: Potential small moves in USD and risk sentiment depending on inflation signals.

items.title: Hot May CPI Keeps Fed on Hold Path
items.summary: May CPI came in at 4.2% year-over-year, the highest since 2023 and driven by energy costs, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will not cut rates soon. This sticky inflation print, released last week, sets the stage for a cautious FOMC statement and could keep upward pressure on yields. Traders care because sustained high inflation reduces odds of near-term liquidity easing that typically supports Bitcoin.
items.impact: Supports stronger dollar and higher yields, pressuring risk assets.

items.title: US and Iran Sign Preliminary Deal to End War
items.summary: President Trump and Iranian officials announced a framework agreement that includes a ceasefire and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. The deal aims to halt military strikes and restore shipping through the vital oil chokepoint. Traders should care because it reduces the risk of further energy supply shocks and supports a risk-on environment for Bitcoin and other assets.
items.impact: Lowers oil prices and boosts risk assets.

items.title: G7 Leaders Focus on Ukraine After Iran Breakthrough
items.summary: At the G7 summit in France, leaders are pushing Ukraine back onto the agenda now that the Iran deal is in place. Trump indicated he will shift focus toward ending the Russia-Ukraine conflict. Traders should watch for any signals on sustained Western support or potential sanctions relief that could affect global risk sentiment.
items.impact: Mixed signals on prolonged geopolitical tensions.
